svg.title: CloudWatch and IMDS Observability Workshop Architecture
svg.desc: Top-to-bottom architecture showing local-first Spring Boot telemetry, CloudWatch payload builders, local adapters, and optional real AWS targets.
svg.text: Default path is local and credential-free. Real AWS and IMDS access are explicit opt-in boundaries.
Publishes metric, log, and meter intent.
Explicit metadata read for demos and tests.
Only instanceId, region, AZ are read.
No real AWS calls in default tests. No automatic credentials are read from IMDS.
